desc:
🌈 THE RAINBOW DINOSAURS ARE HERE! 🦖

After 3 long years of waiting, the Rainbow Dinos have finally arrived in Morph World! Head over to Dino Hunt Island to start the epic new Dig Site Quest. Search every corner of the map to uncover the hidden fossils of these long-lost legends and unlock 6 brand-new morphs!

🦴 Update Patch Notes
- 5 Rainbow Dinos: Unlock the Purple Spinosaurus, Red Triceratops, Green Brachiosaurus, Orange Raptor, and Blue T-Rex! 🦖
- Archeologist Blue Morph: Grab your gear and unlock this exclusive new explorer morph! ⛏️
- Fossil Hunt Quest: Scour Dino Hunt Island to dig up hidden ancient fossils! 🗺️

⭐MORPHS | PUZZLES | QUESTS | PARKOUR | PVP⭐

👑 530+ morphs hidden all around the map
🔫 CUSTOM MORPH ABILITIES with Dashes, Ultimates, Damage!
🌈 Morphs like MECHAS, DINOS, KAIJUS, TRAINS & MAGES!?
☠️ 5 Epic Bosses to Battle with Friends!
🗺️ 10 Worlds to Explore Castle, Moon, Circus, Dinosaurs, City, Military!
